tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// bhrūm̐ mtshan rdo rje rwa gdengs thog mda'i rgya can gyi nang tshan rdo rje gro bo lod gyi chog bsgrigs gnam lcags 'bar ba bzhugs//

gu ru padma siddhi pra yatstshaḥ nges pa'i don du dus gsum sangs rgyas dngos// mi bsrun dregs pa'i tshogs kyi gnyen po ru// 'dzam gling che ba'i brtul zhugs rigs sngags 'chang*// thod phreng rtsal gyis byang chub bar du skyongs// mgon khyod rnam rol pha mtha' yas pa las// lha srin gdon bgegs dam sri 'byung po la// nyams nga med pa'i thog brdzis bro brdungs pa// rdo rje slob dpon gtum drag gro lod rtsal// gnam lcags 'bar ba'i phrin las smin byed rnams// rang bzo'i bslad pa med par 'khrul med du// legs bkod nag po bdud sde'i srog rtsa la// bsnun pa'i rdo rje pha lam 'di na 'bar//

bhrūm̐ mtshan rdo rje rwa gdengs thog mda'i rgya can gyi nang tshan rdo rje gro lod gnam lcags 'bar ba'i chog bsgrigs zur du bkod pa 'di la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum las/ las gzhung dag la sngon 'gro'i chos bdun te// dngos gzhi'i chos ni nyi shu rtsa lnga 'o// rjes kyi las khrigs bcu gcig sgo nas bstan// sngon du rten dkram bgegs la gtor ma gtong*/ khrus byas go bgos bdud rtsi yang dag myong*//

na mo/ bla med bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dpal// sku gsung thugs mchog dkon mchog gsum gyi dngos// sgo gsum dad pas 'di bzung byang chub bar// bdag sogs 'gro kun gus pas skyabs su mchi// bde gshegs rig 'dzin skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung// 'gro ba'i don du smon 'jug sems bcas te// sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor gsang sngags kyi// dam tshig sdom pa rtag tu bskyang bar bgyi// hūm̐ dmar dwangs ma 'od kyi 'phro 'du yis// bde gshegs rig 'dzin ma lus spyan 'dren gshegs// tshogs gnyis gsog phyir rten gyi mchog tu bzhugs// dga' mgu rangs pa'i sems kyis gus phyag 'tshal// dngos su 'byor dang yid sprul mchod pas mchod// sdig pa'i tshogs dang dam tshig nyams chag bshags// dge tshogs mdzad pa kun la yi rang ngo*// theg gsum chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// 'gro la phan mdzad mya ngan mi 'dar gsol// bdag gzhan dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// 'gro ba kun gyi yang dag gnas par shog /hūm̐/ kun khyab ye shes nyid yin kyang*// glo bur 'khrul pa'i sems can la// byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang*// btang snyoms lam bstan mnyam nyid kyi// 'od gsal chos sku thob par shog /
dang po bka' bsgo mtshams bcad pa ni/

hūm̐/ ye shes rol pa dpal gyi skur gsal bas// sku gsung thugs las byung ba'i khro tshogs kyis// bgegs rigs ma lus rgya mtsho'i mthar bskrad phyir// drag po sngags kyi bsrung mtshams lhun gyis grub// oṃ sumbha ni sumbha ni
sogs/

hūm̐/ ye shes rol pa dpal gyi thugs las byung*// rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri rgya gram dang*// mda' mtshon phur bu me dpung phyogs mtshams gtams// bsil ba'i rlung yang gnas der 'da' mi 'gyur// oṃ badzra tsakra tikṣa karma kī la ya dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐/ ye shes rol pa dpal gyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las sprul pa khro bo'i tshogs// 'jigs sku rngam sgra rno dbal mtshon char 'beb// bar mtshams med par khro bo'i sprin chen 'khrigs// oṃ badzra kro ta sarba sa ma ya ru lu ru lu hūm̐ phaṭa/
gnyis pa brda sgo ni/

hūm̐/ ye shes rol pa dpal gyi dkyil 'khor ni// kun nas ma 'dres yongs su khyab cing brdal// rang ngo ma shes yul drug rtog pas bcings// rang rig don gyi 'char sgo dbye ru gsol// hūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭa/
gsum pa brda'i phyag 'tshal ba ni/

hūm̐/ ye shes rol pa kun snang rig pa'i sku// spro dang bsdu ba yongs ye mi 'tshal yang*// rang ngo ma 'tshal tha dad blos bcings pa// rang shes 'khrul pa bral phyir phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ
bzhi pa dam bca' ba ni/

hūm̐/ ye shes rol pa dpal gyi lha tshogs rnams// ye nas rang dang tha dad gnyis med cing*// ma rig dbang gis gnyis su bzung lags kyang*// deng nas bzung ste gnyis med gcig tu bzung*/ oṃ badzra tsitta hūm̐/
lnga pa byin dbab pa ni/

hūm̐/ ye shes rol pa sku gsung thugs kyi lha// rang rtsal 'gag med nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs spyan 'dren dgug gzhug bcings// gnyis med brtan bzhugs byin dbang bskur du gsol// oṃ badzra kro ta sa ma ya ru lu ru lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ā be sha ya a āḥ
drug pa mchod gtor byin gyis brlabs pa ni/

hūm̐/ ye shes rol pa snang srid dag pa la// rang rtsal ma 'gag mchod pa'i cho 'phrul gyis// kun bzang mchod sprin mchog rol byin brlabs nas// ye shes lnga rdzogs sku gsung thugs su brlabs// sarba pū dza me gha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā bha ling ta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐/ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ gaṇḍe hūm̐/ kī la ya hūm̐/
bdun pa bshags pa bya ba ni/
hūm̐/ ye shes rol pa'i cho 'phrul lha rnams dgongs// ye nas rang dang gnyis med byang chub sems// rang rig ye shes blo mchog don ma ldan// 'khrul shes 'khrul sangs rang bzhin dbyings su bshags//
yi ge brgya pa bzlas/
nā ra ka /pre ta ka /tirya ka /ne be sha /de wa a li bi shuddhe/ dakṣa ka shuddhe bi shuddhe swā hā//
dngos gzhi'i ting 'dzin rim pa gsum las/ dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/

hūm̐/ chos rnams skye med 'od gsal nam mkha'i dbyings// gzung dang 'dzin bral rang byung kun tu brdal// gcig dang du ma'i rnam pa kun bral ba// snying po mchog gi ting 'dzin yongs la khyab// oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/
gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/

hūm̐/ ma 'gag gsal ba rig pa'i rtsal snang ni// kun tu ma 'dres kun la khyab pa yi// snying rje chen po 'od lnga'i mdangs ldan pa// nam mkha' bzhin du phyogs ris med pa bsgom// oṃ dharmā dhā tu sa ma ti hūm̐/
gsum pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/

hūm̐/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin snying rje che// snying rje'i ting 'dzin stong nyid rdo rje sems// zung 'jug 'od gsal gser gyi rdo rje ni// rtse lnga hūm̐ bcas stong pa'i mkha' la gsal/ oṃ bho dhi tsitta sa ma ti hūm̐/
gnyis pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni/

hūm̐ dmar cho 'phrul hūm̐ lnga chad pa las// me chu rlung gis thams cad stong par sbyangs// e yaṃ ra sum raṃ keṃ 'byung rim lnga// nam mkha' rlung chu sa me ri rab brtsigs/ e ga ga na maṇḍa la/ yaṃ karma rakṣa haṃ/ ra rakta maṇḍa la/ su sukme maṇḍa la/ ki ni ri ti maṇḍa la/
gsum pa gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed pa ni/

bhrūm̐ las thod pa rin chen gzhal yas khang*// dbus su gru gsum dmar nag dkyil 'khor la// zla gam dmar po thod pa'i ra ba can// phyi rol lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi ldan// mgo bo skam po'i phreng bas zlum por bskor// de'i phyi gru bzhi sgo bzhi gzhal yas khang*// phyogs skyong bcu yis rtsig pa'i rmang gzhi byas// nang ni bhandha skam rlon rnying pa yi// rtsig par gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzer gyis btab// phyi ni sna tshogs rin chen las grub pa// dkar ser dmar ljang nag po'i rtsig pa can// bar du lha chen brgyad kyi rtsig pas gtams// rtsig steng rin chen rus pa'i pha gu la// rgyu ma rlon pa'i drwa ba drwa phyed 'phyang*// de steng rin chen rus pa spel ma yi// mda' yab pu shu rtsig pa'i rtsa ba na// 'dod snam dmar por mchod pa'i lha mos gang*// rgyal chen bzhi dang thod pa skam po las// grub pa'i ka ba brgyad kyis legs btegs pa'i// thod pa rlon pa'i ka gzhu rab tu brjid// klu chen brgyad kyi gdung mas phyogs mtshams bres// de la mdzes pa'i rdo rjes rgyan du spud// gza' chen brgyad kyi bad phur btang ba la// rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad gral lcam byas// bdud rtsi lnga las grub pa'i zhal ba can// dbus kyi lte ba phyur bu'i mtho ba'i rtser// padmas brtsegs pa'i tsitta'i tog gis brgyan// sgo bzhir ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa yi// rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng*// padma chos 'khor bcu gsum gdugs ri dwags// mgo snying tog mdzes zhing chen rgyal mtshan dang*// lag pa'i 'phen dang skra yi rnga yab can// dbang po'i me tog spel ma'i phreng ba g.yo// mdor na rngam brjid mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spud// phyi rol pad ra dur khrod chen po brgyad// rdo rje'i ra ba bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar// dbus kyi gru gsum dmar nag dkyil 'khor steng*// paṃ las sna tshogs padma mdzes pa'i gdan// a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba// ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'bar// bam las ru tra pho mo bsnol ba yi// gan rkyal kha sbub brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du//
bzhi pa gtso 'khor bskyed pa ni/

rgyu yi rdo rje hūm̐ bcas gdan babs las// che ba'i che mchog padma thod phreng rtsal// sku mdog dkar la 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan pa// phyag gnyis sdigs mdzub bsdigs tshul rab byung chas// stag lpags steng na skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// sku yi 'od kyis dgra bgegs zil gyis gnon// shin tu mi bsrun gdul dka'i gnyen po ru// de nyid gnas 'gyur skad cig dran rdzogs su// 'chol ba'i khro rgyal rdo rje gro lod rtsal// zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum 'jigs su rung*// spyan gsum sdang mig mche rnon aṃ gtsigs can// smin ma sma ra dmar ser me ltar 'bar// dbu skra khams nag stug po spungs shing 'khyil// phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs// g.yon pa gnam lcags phur bus dgra snying gzir// gsang gos mthing kha zab ber g.yang lugs steng*// gser gyi pa tra ha ris snam sbyar gsol// snyan cha dung long rin chen rus pas spras// mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang*// zhabs gnyis sag lham gsol zhing g.yas bskum pas// dmu stag mi zan mgo bo'i steng nas mnan// g.yon pa tshang steng brkyang ste gar gyis 'gyings// sku las khro chung rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phro// rtsibs bzhir padma nyi ma'i gdan steng du// shar nas rim bzhin dri za 'chi bdag klu /gnod sbyin sgo bzhir zhing rkyang gdan steng na// gtso bo'i thugs las hūm̐ ya hrīḥhūm̐ dang*// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ'aphros pa yongs gyur las// shar du phyag rdor zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// mthing nag g.yas pa gser gyi rdo rje gsor// lho ru gshin rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// sku mdog ser po g.yas pas 'khor lo bskor// nub tu rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// dmar nag rta skad 'tsher zhing g.yas padma// byang du me dbal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// smug nag g.yas pas me yi tho ba 'phyar// bzhi ka'ang g.yon pa lcags kyi phur bu gdengs// dur khrod chas brgyad gar dgu'i tshul gyis 'gyings// zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang stabs su bzhugs// sgo bzhir dkar ser dmar ljang khro mo'i nyams// lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu g.yas// g.yon pa thams cad sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur bsdigs// rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas spras zhing lpags kyi// stod g.yogs gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can// zhabs gnyis phyed skyil gar stabs tshul gyis bzhengs// gtso 'khor dgu ka dus kyi byin za ltar// rab 'bar ye shes me dpung klong na bzhugs// gzhal yas khang gi thog mtshams bar snang la// gtso bo'i dbu gtsug rig 'dzin rdo rje chos// mthing nag rdo rje dril 'dzin thor tshugs can// rin chen rus rgyan dar gos skyil krung mdzad// yum chen rdo rje rnal 'byor sku la 'khril// de'i phyi dus gsum sangs rgyas padma 'byung*// gsang gos zab ber chos gos mnyen zhu can// rdo rje thod pa kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum bsnams// skyil krung mdzad cing srid gsum zil gyis gnon// de'i phyi lha yi me tog rgyal po'i tshul// mnyam gzhag utpal 'dzin steng ral gris mtshan// de'i phyi 'ja' tshon khor yug sum rim gyi// nang mar padma nyi ma'i gdan steng du// sprul pa'i rig 'dzin chen po rnam pa brgyad// shar du slob dpon chen po hūm̐ kā ra// rdor sems gsang gos dkar po phu thung can// phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol// lho ru slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen ni// gshin rje'i gsang gos mthing nag phu thung can// be con 'phyar zhing g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// nub tu slob dpon nā gārdzu na ni// dbang gi gsang gos dmar smug phu dung can// gseg shang bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams// byang du slob dpon pra bha hasti ni// phur pa'i gsang gos ljang nag phu thung can// phyag gnyis rdo rje rgya gram po ti 'dzin// shar lhor slob dpon dha na saṃskṛ ta// dbyings rig gsang gos smug nag phu dung can// cang te'u bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thogs// lho nub mkhas pa bi ma mi tra ni// che mchog gsang gos smug nag phu dung can// phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag steng na tshe bum 'dzin// nub byang slob dpon gu hya tsand+ra ni// dbang sdud gsang gos lding dmar phu thung can// phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pa zhags pa bsnams// byang shar slob dpon shintaṃ garbha ni// drag po'i gsang gos mthing nag phu thung can// phyag g.yas thog 'phen g.yon pas gri gug 'dzin// kun kyang sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs// dbu la mdzes pa'i mnyen zhu padma can// sprul sku'i cha byad dar gyi chos gos gsol// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung tshul gyis bzhugs/

khor yug bar mar padma nyi zla'i steng*// shar du pad 'byung mthing nag rgyan drug spras// rtse lnga sdigs mdzub yum 'khyud skyil krung mdzad// lho ru mchog sred dkar po thod rnga g.yas// pad phor rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi gos// nub tu nyi 'od ser po kha ṭwāṃ dang*// sdigs mdzub nyi zer zhags 'dzin stag sham dkris// phyag rgya drug dang rin chen rgyan gyis spud// byang du seng sgrog mthing nag lcags rdor dang*// sdigs mdzub thor tshug dar bcings dor stabs bsgrad// seng lpags stod g.yogs stag gi sham thabs gsol// shar lhor padma saṃ bha dge slong tshul// thod pa rin chen dang ldan mchog sbyin g.yon// lho nub padma rgyal dmar dar dmar gos// lcags sgrog ḍā ru me long yig drug mtshan// nub byang shāka seng ser po dge slong chas// sa gnon mnyam gzhag lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang*// byang shar gro lod smug nag khro zhing gtum// gcer bu rgyan drug stag sham rdo rje g.yas// g.yon pa phur bsgril dmar ser dbu skra brdzes// stag lpags steng na zhabs gnyis dor stabs bzhugs/ khor yug phyi mar dar 'bol gdan steng na// shar du nam snying dar sham chos gos dang*// paṇa zhu lu ma nyi zer la chibs tshul// g.yas pa sdigs mdzub g.yon pa pus steng bkab// lho ru gnubs chen thor tshugs dar dmar bcings// gos dkar sngags 'chang chas ldan brag ngos la// phur pa 'debs shing raksha'i phreng ba g.yon// nub tu rgyal mchog dge slong gcer sham can// phyag gnyis sa gnon dbu gtsug rta skad sgrog

/byang du mtsho rgyal rnal 'byor ma yi chas// g.yas pa sdigs mdzub mi ro gson por slong*// g.yon pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin// shar lhor 'brog mi gos dkar thor tshugs sogs// sngags 'chang phyag g.yas rdo rje gdengs pa yis// ma mo bran bkol g.yon pa gdan la brten// lho nub gnyags chen dzñā na sngags 'chang chas// brag las phab pa'i bdud rtsi thod par bskyil// nub byang dpal gyi seng ge rab byung chas// paṇa zhu gsol zhing dregs pa las la bkol// byang shar bai ro rab byung paṇa zhu dmar// dpral ba'i dbus na gsal ba'i ye shes spyan// chos 'chad glegs bam drag sngags dmod pa grub// gzhan yang lhun grub phyag rgya tshe la dbang*// rnam par smin sogs rig 'dzin grangs med dang*// 'og tu dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs// sprin gyi phung po lta bur 'khrigs par gyur//
lnga pa byin rlabs dbang bskur bya ba ni/

hūm̐/ thams cad sku gsung thugs dang ye shes ldan// dbang chen dbang bskur mthu rtsal byin gyis brlabs// phyag rgya bzhi ldan ye nas grub pa'i ngang*// thams cad byang chub sems su lhun gyis grub// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ swā aṃ hāḥ
drug pa spyan 'dren pa ni/

hūm̐/ gsal brtan ting 'dzin ye shes rol pa las// sgyu 'phrul gar ldan dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs// dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa'i pho brang nas// thugs rje smon lam dbang gis gshegs su gsol// e hye hi bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ shya hoḥ e a rālli hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ
bdun pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/

hūm̐/ gdod nas gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang nyid la// blo sbyong phyir du dam tshig ye shes sems// chu la chu bzhag sgyu ma ji bzhin du// du mar snang yang ro gcig brtan par bya// kā ya wā ka tsitta tiṣṭha badzra/
brgyad pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/

hūm̐/ bla ma bde gshegs khro rgyal lha yi tshogs// rang shes 'khrul bral brda dang gar gyi phyag /rnam rtog ye shes chen por rtogs bya'i phyir// sri zhu gus pas 'phrul dga'i tshul phyag 'tshal// na mo pu ru sha hoḥ a ti pū hoḥ pra titstsha hoḥ
dgu pa phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa ni/

hūm̐/ tha mal rtog pa rnam dag phyag rgya'i brda// gar gyis rab mtshon don gyi lhar gsal phyir// gtso dang 'khor bcas ting 'dzin cho 'phrul gyi// rol pa ma 'dres phyag rgya'i mchod pa 'bul// ma hā mu dra pū tsa hoḥ
bcu pa glu bro ye shes kyi mchod pa ni/

hūm̐/ ye shes glu bro don gyi brda mtshon nas// dga' ba bcu drug glu dbyangs bro dang gar// yang dag don rtogs rang byung rang la mchod// rtogs pa'i ye shes rang gnas bstan du gsol// ma hā dzñā na te na hūm̐/ te na te te hūm̐/
bcu gcig pa phyi'i nye bar mkho ba'i mchod pa ni/

hūm̐/ ting 'dzin cho 'phrul ye shes rol pa las// pha rol phyin pa drug rdzogs mchod pa'i rdzas// nam mkha'i khams su sgyu ma'i tshul bstan pa// rang byung rig pa don gyi lha la 'bul// oṃ badzra a ha ra a ha ra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai widye shabda pū tsa hoḥ
bcu gnyis pa nang 'dod yon drug gi mchod pa ni/
hūm̐/ gsang ba yum gyi bde ba dam pa ni// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos rnams te// 'dod yon ma 'gag rang byung lha mo yi// bde ba dam pa sems kyi rgyan du 'bul// pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa pū tsa hoḥ
bcu gsum pa gsang ba dug lnga'i mchod pa ni/
hūm̐/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rang bzhin dam pa ni// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang*// phrag dog rnam dag sku lnga ye shes lnga// sbyor sgrol dam pa lam gyi mchod pa 'bul// ha la pañtsa hoḥ
bcu bzhi pa dug gsum rten gyi mchod pa ni/

hūm̐/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnam pa gsum// sha khrag rus pa rdzas su lhun gyis grub/ khams gsum dag pa sku gsung thugs dang ldan// dam tshig gsum gyi mchod pa dam pa 'bul// ma hā maṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti pū tsa hoḥ
bco lnga pa sman gyi che ba'i yon tan brjod de 'bul zhing dngos grub blang ba ni/

hūm̐/ rang byung gdod nas grub pa rdzas kyi mchog /sha lnga bdud rtsi rigs lnga ye shes lnga// dag mnyam rtogs pas rang byung lha lnga mchod// sku gsung thugs kyi siddhi bstsal du gsol// sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ kā ya wā ka tsitta sarba siddhi oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ
bcu drug pa dam rdzas gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/

khyad par rmad byung dam rdzas 'dod yon lnga// sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig mchog gi rten// zag med bdud rtsi gtor ma'i longs spyod rgyan// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul// ma hā bha lingta khā hi/
bcu bdun pa ma chags rakta'i mchod pa ni/

hūm̐/ bde chen ye shes 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu// padma rakta chags pa chen po'i tshogs// ma lus gcig bsdus 'khor skyon dag pa'i rdzas// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul// ma hā rakta khā hi/
bco brgyad pa gsang nan dza gad kyi mchod pa ni/

hūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdud rtsi 'chi med rdzas// rgyu gnyis rkyen gsum bdud rtsi bzhi sbyar nas// dkar dmar khams kyi bde ba bskyed pa'i phyir// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul// sarba pañtsa a mṛta dza gad khā hi/
bcu dgu pa sbyor ba gnyis med bde ba'i mchod pa ni/

hūm̐/ thabs kyi rdo rje bde chen waṃ gyi dpal// shes rab padma e yig rnam thar gsum// thabs shes gnyis med dga' bzhi mnyam sbyor ba// zag med rdzu 'phrul lam gyi mchod pa 'bul// oṃ padma yo gi ni badzra pra be sha ya phaṭa/
nyi shu pa bdag rtog bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni/

hūm̐/ yang dag pa yi ye shes rdo rje yis// 'khor ba'i bag chags gtan nas bcom byas te// gnas ngan sgrib pa'i dgra dpung gzhom pa'i phyir// gsang ba mkha' gsang dbyings su bsgral mchod 'bul// ma traṃ ru tra pra bhañdza ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ti hūm̐ e yaṃ spha ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/
nyer gcig pa ye shes lnga'i bstod pa ni/

hūm̐/ mnyam nyid dag pa rgyal ba ye shes sku /rtsol med rang byung ā li kā li'i sgra /rtog med spros bral 'od gsal thig le'i thugs// rtsol ba dang bral lhun grub yon tan gter// rang bzhin ma nges phrin las lhun gyis grub/ khyab bdag rig pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod//
nyer gnyis pa bshags pa bya ba ni/

hūm̐/ rang byung rig pa'i lha tshogs rnams// rang las gzhan du med phyir dgongs// ye nas gnyis med ye shes la// blo yis bcos pa rang sar bshags// oṃ badzra gu ru kro ta rā dza sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra gu ru kro ta rā dza twe no pa tiṣṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shre ya ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badzra gu ru kro ta rā dza ma me muñtsa/ badzrī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa a hūm̐ phaṭa/
brgya stong nyer gcig bdun la sogs// skabs dang sbyar te bzla bar bya// nyer gsum pa dag pa ni/

lha la sems gtad rnam pa gsal ba dang*// rtse gcig dngos su lta ba'i nga rgyal gyis// che mchog padma dbang drag 'gro la chags// zhal gcig skye med chos skus gdug pa 'dul// phyag gnyis thabs shes zung 'jug phrin las rdzogs// zhabs gnyis dor stabs mtha' gnyis rnam par gnon// 'chol ba'i khro rgyal sna tshogs rgyan gos kyis// grangs med nyon mongs dug lnga ma lus dag /gar dgu'i nyams kyis sku gsung thugs su grub// dbu skra khams nag chos kun dbyings su gcig /padma chags med nyi zla tshogs gnyis bsags// mgo phreng ro gdan 'du byed rnam par dag /ye shes me dpung sgrib gnyis snying po bsregs// gtso 'khor lnga yis ye shes lnga mngon byed// sgo ma bzhi ni tshad med rnam bzhir rdzogs// gzhal yas khang gis snod kyi ma dag sbyangs// srung ba'i 'khor los ye shes sku lnga rdzogs// snang stong sgyu lus me long lta bur dag /grags stong 'pho chen bcu gnyis dbu mar rdzogs// rig stong 'ja' 'dra lus ngag yid gsum po// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar rang bzhin yin// snying po sku dang ye shes 'od lnga'i gdangs// skye 'chi med pa g.yung drung 'pho 'gyur bral//
nyer bzhi pa 'dzab bzla ba ni/

thugs kar pad nyir hūm̐ la sngags kyis bskor// dregs pa zil mnan rgyal ba sras bcas mchod// byin rlabs tshur bsdus mthu stobs nus pa bskyed// phar 'phros 'gro rnams bla ma'i sa la bkod// mgar gyi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba lta bur 'khrugs// rig rtsal ngar chen ngang nas gsang ba'i sngags// ma yengs chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bzla bar bya// oṃ badzra gu ru rdo rje gro bo lod lo ka sarba hūm̐ hūm̐/
ci rigs pa bzla/
oṃ badzra kro ta gro bo lod tsaṇḍa dzwa la raṃ raṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ
ces pa gtso bor bzla/

skabs su hūm̐ las me 'bar bas// bdag gzhan log rtog bag chags bsregs// rig pa'i ngar ldan hūm̐ sgra sgrog /'khor du mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// de rnams kun gyis hūm̐ sgra sgrog /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ de skad rig pa'i ngar bskyed brjod// 'jig rten khams kun shigs shig ldeg /stong gsum hūm̐ sgras gang bar bsam// snang srid dbang du 'dus par bsam// 'khor ba dong nas sprug par bsam// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba duṣṭan ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ
ces bgrang zhing dregs pa gzir/ 'khor rnams kyi snying po ni/

oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya mānta ka ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ padmānta krita ha ya gṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra yaksha karma dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍe ho/
zhes bsnyen/ thun mtshams mchod bstod stong tshigs bya/ nyer lnga pa dngos grub blangs pa ni/
hūm̐/ bla ma rig 'dzin yi dam dang*// mkha' 'gro dam can ma lus dgongs// bdag gis bskyed rdzogs bsgoms bzlas pa'i// rten 'brel mthun par rab snang shog /kā ya wā ka tsitta siddhi hūm̐/
gsum pa rjes kyi las khrigs kyi/ dang po che ba bskyed pa ni/

hūm̐/ snang srid ye shes dag pa'i zhing*// gzugs snang rang byung rol pa'i rtsal// rang las gzhan du cir mi snang*// thams cad thams cad rang byung yin// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/
gnyis pa phrin las bskul ba ni/

hūm̐/ stong nyid ngang du thams cad zhi// ye shes snying po mthong zhing rgyas// rang sems 'khrul pa dbang du 'du// zang thal rtogs pas bar lag 'jig /shanting puṣṭiṃ ba shaṃ mā ra ya rbod gtong bhyo bzlog /
gsum pa tshogs mchod bya ba ni/

hūm̐/ ye shes 'byung gsum rten 'brel gyis// bsregs sbyangs 'bru gsum sngags byin brlabs// bla ma lha tshogs gshegs shing bzhugs// tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ /na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa'i// tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di// rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// dam skongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// gha na tsakra pū dza khā hi/ sgyu ma'i bde sdug snang ba ltar// med bzhin bsags pa'i sdig sgrib kun// bsod nams tshogs chen 'di yi mthus// ma lus byang zhing dag par shog /
yi ge brgya pa brjod/
e nṛ tri dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad/ phur bu 'bar bas lus srog phral// ral gris dum bur gtubs pa yi// sha khrag rus tshil phung po 'di// rtsa gsum lha tshogs zhal du 'bul// ma hā maṃ sa
sogs brjod/
tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i dge tshogs kyis// sgyu ma rmi lam ji bzhin du// rang gzhan tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas// sku dang ye shes rgyas par shog /
bzhi pa lhag mchod bya ba ni/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐/ hūm̐/ ye shes rol pa'i lha tshogs rnams dang ni// las las grub pa'i mkha' 'gro dbang phyug ging*// ma bdun sring bzhi 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes// 'bar ma dang ni spor ma pho nya'i tshogs// lha srin sde brgyad bka' yi srung mar bcas// ma lus 'dir gshegs zag med bdud rtsi la// rngams shing dgyes pa'i tshul gyis rol du gsol// ma ma sha trun a mu kaṃ phreṃ yaksha badzra bi dzā ya kha kha khā hi khā hi/
lnga pa chad tho ni/

hūm̐ bhyo/ sngon tshe ye shes dpal gyi dam tshig dang*// bar du sprul pa'i rig 'dzin dam tshig dang*// tha ma gang zag dam tshig gnyan po dang*// da lta bdag nyid rnal 'byor dam tshig la// tshul bzhin gtogs pa ma lus 'dir gshegs shig /ji ltar rang rang dam bcas tshul bzhin du// rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// ma hā pañtsa bha ling ta rakta khā hi/
drug pa gtor ma 'phang ba ni/

bhyo/ ngas ni ma nyes rnam rtog bar chad bdud// ma nyes zhabs bskum dbu chums gtor lam phyes// rang srog bdud dang bar chad byed pa'i bgegs// log 'dren steng du bden pa'i zor mda' phob// dgra bgegs sarba sha trum mā ra ya phaṭa/
bdun pa gtor gzhong bshal la sman 'brus bkang ste bdud rtsir brlabs la/ brtan ma skyong ba ni/

hūm̐ bhyo/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis ma mo brtan ma'i tshogs// nag mo dmar mo dkar mo 'bum phrag rnams// gtor ma 'di bzhes rnal 'byor bdag nyid kyis// ci ltar bcol pa'i las la 'bras bu stsol// ma mā/ kha khā/ la lā/ le lāe/ ta tā/ te tāe/ sring 'gro ma pañtsa bha ling ta rakta khā hi khā hi/
brgyad pa gtor gzhong mnan pa ni/

hūm̐/ stong gsum brdal ba dpal gyi gzhal yas khang*// rngam brjid rol pa rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// rkang pa rdo rje 'bar ba'i rol gar gyis// bro brdungs phrin las thams cad lhun gyis grub// shintaṃ puṣṭiṃ ba shaṃ mā ra ya stāṃ bha ya raksha nan: sumbha ni
brjod/ ā li kā li yig brgya bzla/ dgu pa rtag mtha' bsal ba ni/
hūm̐/ rang rig thig le gcig tu brdal ba la// spro dang bsdu ba'i bya ba mi dmigs kyang*// ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i blo rtog sbyang ba'i phyir// thams cad thig le chen por bsdu bar bya/ badzra mu:
bcu pa chad lta bsal ba ni/
hūm̐/ rtag tu mi 'gyur thig le'i snying po zlum// bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i mtha' gnyis bral ba la// chad pa'i stong nyid med pa las grol phyir// rdo rje khro bo dpal chen sku ru shar//
bcu gcig pa bsngo zhing rgyun spyod bya ba ni/
hūm̐/ dus gsum mi dmigs sgyu mar snang ba'i chos// mig 'phrul ji bzhin dge tshogs byang chub tu// yongs su bsngos pas bde gshegs rig 'dzin gyi// go 'phang mchog la 'gro kun sbyor gyur cig /
bkra shis rig 'dzin zhal lung ltar bya'o// ༈ //
gnas khang byi dor/ dbang chas sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshang bar bsags/ rang nyid skad cig gis gtso bo'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ gtor ma dkar dmar gnyis/
raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐
gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/
oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra sa ma dzaḥ
sa spyan drangs/ gong gi sngags mjug tu mdzod sngags sbyar bas bsngos la/

sa bdag lha klu 'khor dang bcas// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi sgrub pa ma thon bar/ khyed la gnas 'di bdag g.yar gyis// gnang ba legs par bstsal du gsol// ci bde bar ni gzhan du song*//
gong gi sngags mjug tu
gatstsha

zhes brjod pas gzhan du gshegs par bsam/ de nas stegs bu'i khar dkyil 'khor dgram/ de steng mañdzi'i khar sgrub gtor dar gyi cod pan can bzhag /mdun du rnam bum bcud ldan kha rgyan gzungs thag dang bcas pa/ las bum/ g.yas su dbu rgyan/ mdun du rdor dril/ g.yon du gsang rdzas/ shes rab ma'i dbang rten/ 'ja' shel/ gzhan sku gsung thugs rten gyi tsaka li/ mig dar/ me tog /dam chu/ dgang blugs/ me dpung*/ ling ga /thod pa/ glang ru/ byad thag /thun/ ro g.yam/ mda' zor/ rdo/ kong bu/ khrag kong rnams gang 'os su bsham/ phyi nang gi mchod pa/ tshogs 'khor/ bgegs gtor/ rdor dril/ rol mo sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams mngon par 'du bgyid/ las byang gi srung 'khor sngon du thun rol mo drags sngags tsham rngam dang bcas bgegs gtor btang nas gzhung bsrangs te dkyil 'khor bsgrub/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du lha bskyed pa la mchod bstod bzlas pa dang*/ las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang rnam 'joms kyi bskyed bzlas byas nas rnam bum dang sgrub gtor gnas brje/ las bum slob dpon gyi lcog rtse'i steng khar 'jog /tshogs mchod 'bul/ slob ma rnams khrus nas dbyung*/ rdo rje slob dpon dbang khang sgo nang du byon par gsol ba 'di ltar gdab pa ni/
hoḥ kye ma gsang chen rigs rnams kun// ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can// bla ma rdo rje gro lod kyi// dbang bskur zab mo bstsal du gsol//
lan gsum gyis zhu ba phul/ lan du/
kye/ bu khyod lam 'dir snying khong nas// mos na dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi// the tshom yid gnyis ldan pa'i rigs// 'di ru ma 'dug phyir dengs shig /
ces brjod pa'i lan du/
bdag ni rtsa ba gsum po spyi/ khyad par bla ma gro bo lod// lhag pa'i skyabs su 'dzin lags pas// rjes su 'dzin pa gnang bar rigs//
zhes brjod/ bgegs gtor btang zhing*/ yungs kar
kyi sgra rol mo dang bcas te phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ slob ma rnams nang du zhugs par/
hoḥ snod dang ldan na smin bya yis/ khas blangs dam la gnas par gyis// dam 'gal na raka gnas su ltung*// de bas rang rgyud dag par gyis//
zhes gnang ba sbyin/ spro ba bskyed cing dam bsgrag pa'i slad du/

kyai/ nyon cig skal ldan theg chen sngags kyi rigs// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin sdug bsngal me yi 'obs// bde ba'i skabs med thar pa'i lam 'tshol ba// legs so legs so 'dir shog bde bar 'dug /'di ni theg chen gsang ba sngags kyi lam// smin dang grol ba dus gcig nyid la 'byung*// 'di 'phrad 'khor ba'i mtsho las thon pa ste// 'gro ba'i lam stegs dga' tshal khyod yin no// de phyir dam tshig dag la nan tan gces// bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dam tshig tu// rtag tu gus pas gsol gdab ting 'dzin bsgom// bzlas pa phyag mchod rdzogs rim dag snang bskyed// 'gro la brtse bas byams dang snying rje bsgom// sgo gsum dal med dge bcu tshul bzhin spyod// sa ma ya hūm̐/
zhes brjod/ maṇḍal phul/
kye kye/ mkha' 'gro'i grong khyer nyams dga' ba// der ni bdag la brtse bar rab dgongs te// dkyil 'khor gzhug cing dbang rnams bskur ba dang*// gsang ba sngags kyi lam rnams bstan du gsol//
zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/
a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐/
zhes mig dar bcings/
oṃ puṣpe siddhi hūm̐/
zhes me tog gtad/ las byang gi skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa rnams bya/ sngags sdom 'dzin pa ni/
hūm̐/ deng nas rigs lnga'i dam tshig sogs// gsang ba sngags kyi sdom bzung nas// 'gro ba ma grol dgrol ba dang*// dbugs dbyung mya ngan 'das la 'god//
ces brjod/

bla ma'i spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rim gyis byung ba slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas lus thams cad 'od kyis gang*/ gnas gsum du bdud rtsi'i thigs pa bzhag pa'i rkyen gyis spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par padma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa/ thugs kar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa gsal btab
par 'bru gsum brjod cing rdo rje bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i sems bskyed pa ni/ snying gar bdud rtsi tsan dan chus brlan la/

kun rdzob snying rjes brgyan pa'i byang chub sems// gang ba'i zla ba snying dbus bsgom byas te// de steng rdo rje reg cing don dam pa// 'od gsal snying po 'od kyi rdo rje ste// gser mdog rgyas pa 'od zer lnga 'phro ba// bsgom par bskul zhing thal sbyar sems gnyis bskyed// oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta u pa dā ya mi/ oṃ su ra ti sa ma ya st+waṃ/ ho siddhi badzra ya tha su khaṃ/
zhes brjod/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/

deng nas theg mchog chos 'di yi// gsang ba gzhan la mi smra sogs// dam bsrungs 'di phyi'i don 'bras thob// min na ye shes sems dpa' ni// sdig par gyur nas snying rtsa za// de bas tshul bzhin yid dam byos// pañtsa a mṛta hrīḥṭha:
zhes dam chu byin nas dam la bzhag /rdo rjer 'jus nas nang du khrid par mos te/
hūm̐ dzaḥ shog cig dkyil 'khor nang zhugs la// phyogs bzhi'i sgor zhugs lha la phyag 'tshal te// gus pa'i sems kyis bde gshegs dngos grub longs// mdzes pa'i grong khyer dga' ba'i mdun du 'dug /
ces brjod
lho yi sgo nas snying rje'i sems nye bar bzhag cing nub tu dga' ba dang*/ byang du btang snyoms shar du byang sems sgoms/ sgo bzhi phyes la shar gyi khyams la bkod
ces brjod/ byin dbab pa ni/
ho: bla ma rdo rje gro lod kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams// da lta nyid du bdag sogs kyi// rgyud la dbab par mdzad du gsol//
zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ bgegs bsangs slob ma las byang bzhin gtso bor bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/

yi ge gsum las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ lus kyi nang kun gang bas sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad sbyangs/ lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo nas che mchog padma thod phreng zhi khro'i lha tshogs la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba byon par bsam
te bzhengs bskul dang spos rol bya zhing rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu
hūm̐
brgya rtsa brgyad kyi mthar/
ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ ā we sha ya a a āḥ
zhes bstim zhing sngags bzlas te spyi bor rdo rje bzhag /
tiṣṭha badzra
gyis brtan par byas la me tog 'dor ba ni/
dkyil 'khor lha tshogs drung du bdag mchi yi// che mchog padma'i dkyil 'khor chen po ru// dngos grub sgrub phyir dbus su me tog dor// sngon sbyangs las 'phro gang yod der 'bab shog /pra tītstsha hoḥ
zhes me tog dor/

zhes gang du babs pa'i gsang mtshan gdags/ cod pan mgo bor bcings te/
cod pan 'di ni dpa' ba'i rtags// smon lam mthun pa'i lhas byin brlabs// bar chad kun gyis mi tshugs shing*// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis mi gos shog /puṣpe a bhi ṣiñtsa mī/
zhes brjod/ rdo rjes mig dbye ba'i stangs ka dang bcas te/

hūm̐/ bu khyod rtsol ba'i sems stobs ma chung bar// dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs lha dang gnyis su med// rtag tu lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs// mnyam par sbyor bas yang dag dngos grub thob// badzra tsakṣu pra we sha ya phaṭa/
ces mig dar bsal/

hoḥ ma rig ling tog ngas bsal rang byung gi /ye shes gsang ba'i brda dang don la ltos// 'dus ma byas shing lhun grub gzhal yas khang*// byang chub phyogs kyi lam rnams 'dril bar rdzogs// 'di mthong byang chub lam du chud pas te// phung po lnga dag bde gshegs rigs lnga dang*// 'byung ba yum dag gsang ba'i lha mo lnga// skye mched drug dang bcu gnyis sems dpa' dang*// yan lag dag pa khro bcu 'bar ba'i tshogs// thams cad ye shes 'bar ba'i sku la rdzogs// 'di ni rang byung don gyi lha yin te// mthong dang bsgom bzlas tshe gcig byang chub thob// bskal pa'i mun pa skad cig nyid la dag /rtag tu dga' mgu rangs pa'i bsam pa yis// dkyil 'khor bri dang sgrub la nan tan byos// a la la hoḥ
zhes brjod cing dkyil 'khor dang lha ngo bstan/ dbang dngos gzhi la maṇḍal phul/
kye ma mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag /bla ma rdo rje gro lod kyi// dbang bzhi bskur zhing sgrib bzhi sbyang*// smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol//
lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/

slob ma gtso bor gsal ba la skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar dbang lha spyan drangs pa rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar bsams te/ hūm̐/ phyi ltar bum pa bzang po la// nang du ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu// rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// rigs lnga'i dbang mchog thob par shog /oṃ badzra gro bo lod sa pa ri wā ra a bhi ṣiñtsa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas spyi bor snang mdzad/ dpral bar mi bskyod pa/ rna ltag g.yas su rin 'byung*/ ltag par 'od dpag med/ rna ltag g.yon du don grub rnams kyis dbu brgyan/
rtsa thor 'di tsam las ma byung zhing rgyas par spro na/

thugs ka'i 'od kyis rigs lnga yab yum dang*// sems dpa' lcam dral khro bo'i tshogs spyan drangs// mchod cing bstod de gnyis med sbyor ba'i tshul// lha tshogs rnams dang gnyis med rol pa'i rdzas// spyi bor bzhag ste dbang 'di bskur bar bya// zhes rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis rigs lnga yab yum sems dpa' lcam dral khro bo khro mo'i tshogs spyan drangs
pa la mchod cing bstod/
slob ma dang bum chu skad cig gis mi bskyod he ru ka yab yum gsal gtab par ye shes pa bstims/ de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum chur bsam
zhing mjug tu mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab pa la mchod nas shis pa brjod/ des mtshon te rin 'byung cod pan gyi dbang sogs la yang rigs 'gre'o//

hūm̐/ rgyal ba kun gyi byang chub sems mchog chu// rang bzhin dag pa ye shes lnga yi dngos// bu khyod byin brlabs dbang mchog dam pa byin// rnam shes dag pa dkyil 'khor lhar gyur cig /oṃ badzra kro dha gro bo lod sa pa ri wā ra badzra badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ mi bskyod rgyas gdab
mchod cing bkra shis brjod//
zhe sdang dag pa me long ye shes sku /rdo rje drag po khros pa'i ngo bor blta//
de nas cod pan rin chen ze prog la// bde gshegs lha bskyed spyan 'dren gnyis med bstims// mgo bo'i gnas lngar gtad la 'di skad brjod//
trāṃ/ bde gshegs kun gyi rig 'dzin rtags// cod pan mi 'gyur phyag rgya lnga dang ldan// bdud las rnam rgyal ye shes sku yi dpal// bu khyod dbang bskur tshor ba lhar gyur cig /
sngags mjug tu/
ratna badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/
mchod bstod rab gnas shis pa kun la brjod// rdo rje lhar bskyed thugs ka dpral ba dang*// spyi bor bzhag cing g.yas su gtad par bya//
hrīḥ sku lnga ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje ni// mi 'gyur snying po sra zhing khong stong med// bdud las rgyal ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje'i dbang 'dis 'du shes lhar gyur cig /
sngags mjug tu/
padma badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ
mchod sogs byas la dril bu lhar bskyed bstim// g.yon du sbyin la legs par dkrol byas te// g.yon gyi dkur brten 'di skad sbyin par bya//
āḥ shes rab gsang ba stong nyid bcu drug ni// dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro grags stong mchog gi gsung*// 'gag med yan lag drug cu'i dbang bskur bas// 'du byed phung po lha ru smin gyur cig /
sngags mjug tu/
karma badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ
mchod sogs byas la me tog spyi bor bzhag /lhar bskyed ye shes 'gugs bstims ming dbang ni//
oṃ/ rdo rje mi 'gyur bde gshegs rgyal ba'i ming*// mjug tu rab gnas sangs rgyas kun dang sbyor// gzugs tshor 'du shes 'du byed dag pa ste// ming dbang 'dis ni gti mug lhar gyur cig /
sngags mjug tu/
buddha badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/
mchod bstod byas pas rig pa'i dbang bskur rdzogs// lha dbang ni/ gtso bo'i tsaka li thogs/

hūm̐/ gsang ba chen po rigs kyi gtso bo mchog /rdo rje drag po mi 'gyur rtags kyi sku /'bar ba'i sku mchog gsung gi nga ro ldan// mi 'gyur g.yung drung thugs su smin gyur cig /oṃ badzra kro ta gro bo lod kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/
zhes spyi bor bstim/
hūm̐/ shar phyogs khro rgyal dpal chen mi bzad pa// dri za 'dul phyir rtags kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/
thugs kar bstim/
hūm̐/ lho phyogs khro rgyal dpal chen mi bzad pa// gshin rje 'dul phyir rtags kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ ya mānta ka kā=
dpral bar bstim/
hūm̐/ nub phyogs khro rgyal dpal chen mi bzad pa/ klu dbang 'dul byed rtags kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ padmānta kṛta kā=
mgrin par bstim/
hūm̐/ byang phyogs khro rgyal dpal chen mi bzad pa// gnod sbyin 'dul byed rtags kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ badzra yaksha kā=
zhes gsang gnas su bstims/
hūm̐/ sgo bzhi skyong mdzad mkha' 'gro rnam pa bzhi// 'gugs 'ching sdom myos rtags kyi dbang bskur ro// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkā=
lte bar mgron thabs kyi lha'i dbang ni/

hūm̐/ lhun grub phyag rgya tshe dbang rnam smin sogs// grangs med rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ khyab bdag dkyil 'khor mgon po rigs kyi gtso// bla ma rdo rje chos kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ gu ru badzra dharmā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ hūm̐/ thugs kyi rig 'dzin rdo rje sems dpa'i sras// nyi zla lta bur ma rig mun pa sel// stong nyid snying rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// slob dpon hūm̐ mdzad thugs kyi dbang= oṃ ma hā hūm̐ kā ra a= hūm̐/ sku yi rig 'dzin rnam par snang mdzad sras// ri rgyal lhun po lta bur gzi brjid che// drag shul thabs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// 'jam dpal gshin rje sku yi dbang= oṃ ma hā mañdzu shrī mi tra a= hūm̐/ gsung gi rig 'dzin snang ba mtha' yas sras// ka la piṅka lta bu sgra dbyangs snyan// zhi ba byams pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// klu sgrub snying po gsung gi dbang= oṃ ma hā nā gārdzu na a= hūm̐/ phrin las rig 'dzin rdo rje gzhon nu'i sras// 'ja' tshon lta bur phrin las so sor gsal// las bzhi lhun gyis grub pas 'gro don mdzad// mchog ldan glang po phrin las dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma hā pra bha wa hasti a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ hūm̐/ dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med bde ba'i sras// thabs kyi rang bzhin rtsa rlung rnam par dag /shes rab rang bzhin mtshan ma spros dang bral// yang dag 'dzin byed dbyings rig dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma hā dha na saṃskṛta dbang=

hūm̐/ 'khor 'das thams cad rig na sangs rgyas te// ma rig 'khrul pa'i rtsa ba bral bas sangs// gser 'gyur rtsi ltar ye shes rang gnas mthong*// dri med bshes gnyen yon tan dbang= oṃ ma hā bi ma la mi tra a= hūm̐/ nus pa thogs med phyag na rdo rje'i sras// rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan sde brgyad bran du bkol// kun la dbang sgyur 'khor 'das sa ler gzigs// gsal ba'i zla ba mchod bstod dbang= oṃ ma hā gu hya tsand+ra a= hūm̐/ drag sngags mngon gyur stobs ldan nag po'i sras// mthu rtsal chen pos gnam lcags thog ltar 'debs// zhing bcu tshar gcod sgrol lam thabs la gnas// zhi ba'i snying po drag po'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma hā gu ru shintaṃ garbha abhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ āḥ chos sku skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// longs sku gsal la ma 'dres gu ru'i sku /sprul sku sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul// sku gsum ngang gi mnyam gzhag ma 'dres gsal// sngon tshe padma khyed dang smon lam gcig /da lta slob ma'i stangs su bdag bzung zhing*// srog gi phyir yang mi gtong sgrub lags na// ye shes dbang chen rab 'byams kun rdzogs shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ hūm̐/ dri med padma ge sar sdong po las// ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub ma lus brnyes// rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas yab yum gyi// dbang bskur dbang chen rab 'byams kun rdzogs shog

/oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ hūm̐/ lho phyogs bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du// yon tan sna tshogs dngos grub sgrub pa brnyes// sdom brtson dge slong padma saṃ bha wa'i// dbang bskur dbang chen rab 'byams kun rdzogs shog /oṃ badzra gu ru padma saṃ bha wa a= hūm̐/ rā ga ra ti'i gnas mchog dam pa ru// shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngos grub brnyes// mkhas pa chen po blo ldan mchog sred kyi// dbang bskur dbang chen rab 'byams kun rdzogs shog /oṃ badzra gu ru dzñā na pra dzñā a= hūm̐/ dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod chen po ru/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i dngos grub brnyes// snang srid zil gnod padma rgyal po yi// dbang bskur= oṃ badzra gu ru padma rā dza a bhi a= hūm̐/ byang phyogs so sa gling gi dur khrod du// 'gro ba ma lus 'dul ba'i dngos grub brnyes// rnal 'byor chen po nyi ma 'od zer gyi// dbang bskur dbang chen rab 'byams kun rdzogs shog /oṃ badzra gu ru surya sarba dharmā.a= hūm̐/ shar phyogs za hor rgyal po'i yul dbus su// bdud rnams 'dul ba'i drag po'i dngos grub brnyes// bcom ldan thub chen shākya seng ge yi// dbang bskur= oṃ badzra gu ru shākya sengha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ hūm̐/ rgya gar dbus 'gyur 'chang gi grong khyer du// log lta mu stegs 'dul ba'i dngos grub brnyes// gtum drag chen po seng ge sgra sgrog gi

/dbang bskur= oṃ badzra gu ru sengha gandhe dharmā dhā tu a= hūm̐/ stag tshang seng ge bsam grub ke'u tshang du// mu stegs dregs pa tshar gcod dngos grub brnyes// 'chol ba'i khro rgyal rdo rje gro lod kyi// dbang bskur= oṃ badzra gu ru gro bo lod lo ka sarba a= hūm̐/ nam yang mi g.yo'i ting 'dzin brtan po rnyed// yon tan khrag 'thung dgongs pa mngon du gyur// chos kyi rgyal po bla ma'i rig pa 'dzin// tshangs pa lha yi me tog dbang bskur ro// oṃ brahma ṇa de wa puṣpa a= hūm̐/ rgya gar yul du khrag 'thung grub pa brnyes// bod kyi yul 'dir mkha' la bya bzhin byon// nyi zer la 'chibs yang dag rig pa 'dzin// dge slong nam mkha'i snying po'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ bikṣu ga ga na garbha a= hūm̐/ sra ba'i brag la phur pas thal byung phug /lha srin bran bkol mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag /brtul zhugs mthar phyin gshin rje'i grub pa brnyes// gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes dbang bskur ro// oṃ mant+ra dhrig buddha dzñā na a bhi ṣañtsi hūm̐/ hūm̐/ sdom gsum khrims ldan rnal 'byor mchog la gzhol// gtsug nas khams gsum khyab pa'i rta skad sgrog /gsung gi grub brnyes dbang chen rig pa 'dzin// ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dbang bskur ro// oṃ pa ra ma dzi na sā ra a= hūm̐/ mkha' spyod dbang mo rje btsun sgrol ma yi// sgyu 'phrul gar mkhan tha mal bud med tshul// mi ro gson bslangs phur pa'i rig pa 'dzin// mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dbang bskur ro// oṃ ḍā ki nī dzñā na sa mu drā dzi na a=

hūm̐/ mngon rdzogs khrag 'thung rgyal pos byin brlabs pas// srid pa bde 'gro grub pa'i mthu stobs kyis// mo rgyud bran bkol ma mo'i rig pa 'dzin// 'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes dbang bskur ro// oṃ bidyā dhā ra shrī dzñā na a= hūm̐/ rlung sems dbang bsgyur ting 'dzin nus pa'i mthus// skam po'i brag las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun phab// rdzu 'phrul mnga' brnyes che mchog rig pa 'dzin// slob dpon ye shes gzhon nu'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ mant+ra dhā ra dzñā na ku mā ra a= hūm̐/ snang ba ka nas dag pa'i 'phrul chen pos// lha srin sde brgyad srog la mnga' bsgyur nas// bran du rab bkol mchod bstod rig pa 'dzin// rlangs chen dpal gyi seng ge'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ ārya tsarya shrī singha a= hūm̐/ don gyi paṇa chen sgra bsgyur 'jig rten mig /ye shes spyan ldan dregs pa las la bskul// dgra bgegs tshar gcod drag sngags rig pa 'dzin// lo chen rnam par snang mdzad dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma hā lo tsā ba bai ro tsa na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/
gsung dbang ni/ gtso 'khor gyi sngags gser gyis bris pa mgrin par bzhag ste/

sngags kyi rgyal po gsang chen hūm̐ gi sgra /de nyid rlung dang 'grogs te rtag tu zlos// hūm̐/ ma bcos rig pa lha dang gnyis su med// padma le brgan thugs su thig ler bskyil// lha sngags ye shes rdzogs pa'i dbang 'di longs//
sngags rnams kyi mjug tu
wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ
dang sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byas nas/ phreng ba spyi bor 'jog cing
dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ
zhes brjod/ lha so so'i phyag mtshan dngos sam tsaka li thugs kar gtug ste/
hoḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs mchog 'bar ba'i gzi// brjod bral bde chen zung 'jug dbang bskur ro// oṃ kro ta gro bo lod sa pa ri wā ra tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/
chas dbang ni/

hūm̐/ sngags gos mthing kha rnam sbyar rab byung chas// rgyal po'i cha lugs za 'og rtse ber dang*// rin chen rus rgyan dung long mi mgo'i phreng*// rmad byung rgyan dang chas kyi dbang 'di longs// oṃ gu ru kro ta rā dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ glang chen ko rlon brjid cing gti mug 'joms// zhing chen g.yang gzhi thabs mkhas 'dod chags dag /stag sham ser khra'i rgyal mtshan dregs pa 'joms// sbrul nag chun 'khor zhe sdang gnas su dag /thod phreng rus rgyan pha rol phyin drug ldan// mgo rlon do shal bdud dpung zil gyis gnon/ khrag zhag thal chen mkha' 'gro dpa' bo sdud// rngam brjid rol pa rgyan dang chas bcur ldan// oṃ shrī he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/
zhes sku la bkon pa'i tshul bya/ bsgral dbang ni/ 'brub khung du dam sri'i liṅga bcas/ gser skyems gzu dpang*/ 'gug gzhug byas rjes/

phur pa stod che mchog padma thod phreng la smad phur bu mgar gyi sol me nas bton pa lta bu rdo rje me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro bar bskyed do// hūm̐/ mthu stobs spyod pa brtul zhugs rgya mtsho'i dpal// rdo rje 'bar bas sa dgu'i rtog pa 'joms// ri rab phur bus rnam rtog bdud dpung 'dul/ khro rgyal rigs 'dus sku gsung thugs dang gcig /dbang mchog 'dis ni chos nyid don rtogs te// bde gshegs kun gyi mthu stobs rtsal ldan shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm hā gu ru badzra kī la ya kro ta rā dza siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/
zhes pas phur pa gtad nas rtsa sngags mjug tu bsad sngags btags te bsgral du 'jug /ling ro zhal stob bya/ hom dbang ni/ me dpung dgang blugs thogs la/

hūm̐/ sdig sgrib nad gdon sreg pa'i ye shes me// sbar byed thabs shes dgang blugs 'di gtad pas// kun rdzob las bzhi yongs grub mtshan 'dzin gyi// rnam rtog dbyings su mi dmigs dbang thob shog /oṃ badzra kro ta gro bo lod sa pa ri wā ra agne dzwa la raṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/
zhes gtad/
mthu dbang ni/ liṅga thod pa glang ru thun byad thag ro g.yam sa tshon rnams thogs la/

hūm̐/ dgra bgegs rgyal 'gong 'byung po dam sri'i rigs// gsod cing mnan par byed pa'i rdzas 'di yis// tshe srog nus mthu brlag cing bskal pa ru// thar med drag po mthu yi dbang bskur ro// oṃ badzra kro ta gro bo lod sa pa ri wā ra dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/
zhes gtad/ zor dbang ni/ mda'/ rdo/ kong bu/ khrag thun rnams thogs la/

hūm̐/ dgra bgegs 'byung po'i steng du 'bar ba'i thog /shugs drag 'phangs pa'i sbyor bas brlag nus pa'i// za lam bstan pas rjes shul ma stongs bar// mthar byed drag po zor gyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ badzra kro ta gro bo lod sa pa ri wā ra dgra bgegs kyi steng du thuṃ ri li li a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/
zhes brjod/ sgrub gtor btegs la/

dpal gyi gtor ma dar gyi rgyan dang bcas// gzhal yas lhar bskyed bu yi spyi bor bzhag /spos chen rol mo me tog char dbab cing*// gnyis med bstims la mthu rtsal rdzogs dbang sbyin// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid dpal chen po/ khro rgyal 'dus pa badzra hūm̐ kā ra// 'jigs byed dregs pa rdo rje 'khor lo'i sku /mthu chen rdzogs pa'i dbang 'di bu yis longs// ma hūm̐/ ma hūm̐/ ma hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥkā ya wā ka tsitta sarba ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ
zhes spyi bor 'jog cing lha tshogs rnams bstims te cung zad rol/ gsang dbang la maṇḍal phul zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni/
hoḥ bla ma yab yum gsang ba'i bdag /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bdag la ston// bde ba chen po'i dngos grub nod// gsang ba'i dbang chen bskur du gsol//
lan gsum/ 'bru gsum brjod cing gdong g.yogs bcings/

slob dpon che mchog padmar gsal ba'i gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par nor bur oṃ rtse mor phaṭa dang bcas pa/ phyag rgya khros ma sngo nag gri thod 'dzin par gsal ba'i mkha' a las padma as mtshan pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ yum gyi mkhar babs pas thod chang bdud rtsi sbyar ba dang bsres nas/ hrīḥ bde gshegs kun gyi byang chub sems// gnyis med ye shes gsang ba'i rdzas// sha lnga bdud rtsi'i dpal dang ldan// ye shes dbang 'di khyod la sbyin// hūm̐ ma hā su kha hoḥ mgrin par myang la ngo bor lta// rlung gi sbyor bas bdud rtsi bsdu// lus sems bde chen 'od kyi sku /thig le dmar po gcig tu bsam//
zhes brda sprad de mig dar bsal/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la/ maṇḍal phul te gsol ba gdab pa ni/
gnyis med ye shes bde chen po// mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog bde// rlung sems bsre ba'i thabs chen po// 'khor lo bde mchog dbang chen skur//
zhes lan gsum dang*/ mig dar 'ching la/

hūm̐/ bde gshegs kun gyi gsang ba 'dzin pa'i yum// lha mo 'di bsten bde gshegs dngos grub thob// bshang gci la sogs btsog zas za ba dang*// bud med la gus bha gar 'o byed pa/ khyod ni spro bar nus sam rigs kyi bu//
zhes brjod/ lha mo sprad la spro ba'i gtam 'di bya/

lha mo bde ster dga' ba'i ma// bdag gis gsang ba sngags kyi lam// byang bar byas te khyod la spro// btsog par blta ba log pa ste// bram ze dang ni nyan thos kyis// grol dang thar pa ci phyir thob// bde chen thabs kyi theg pa ni// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig ste// bdag gis khyod bsten dngos grub 'dod//
ces brjod

lha mos bde gshegs kun// dpang por bzhugs pa'i tshul chen po// 'di nyid yin no rigs kyi bu// theg dman dang ni tha mal dang*// ma shes thabs la mi mkhas pa// de dag khyod kyis bya ba min// bdag ni bde gshegs bskyed pa'i yum// rdo rje rnal 'byor gsang ba'i mdzod// dpa' bo thabs kyi rdo rje 'dzin// snang stong lus kyi pho brang na// bde stong rol pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs// lhun grub rig stong rol pa'i rtsal// ma rmad bde ba'i longs spyod rol// padma bhañdza mokṣa hoḥ slob ma che mchog padmar gsal ba'i gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa nor bur oṃ/ phyag rgya khros ma sngo nag gri thod 'dzin par gsal ba'i mkha' a las padma as mtshan pa/ yab kyi rdo rje nor bu'i rtsa bar rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i g.yas la oṃ dkar po/ g.yon la āḥdamar po/ dbus su hūm̐ mthing kha/ rtse mor phaṭa yig ser po bsgom/ snyoms par zhugs pas khams kyi dwangs ma rnams 'khor lo bzhir rim pa bzhin dga' ba/ mchog dga'/ khyad dga'/ lhan skyes kyi dga' ba rnams rgyud la skyes nas/ slar yang rlung 'pho ba med pa'i mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi ngo sprad de gdong g.yogs bkrol/ snang srid bde chen rang byung du// stong pa'i dbyings su mnyam par blta// lus kyi 'khrul 'khor sna tshogs kyis// chang la phabs rtsi ji bzhin du// lus sems snang ba thams cad la// bde stong gis ni khyab par blta//
zhes brjod/ dbang bzhi pa la maṇḍal phul/

ma traṃ gi lto bar bzlog dkyil chos 'byung gru gsum zla gam gsum ldan 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud rdor ra dang bcas pa'i steng du nas nag gtso bor gyur pa'i 'bru sna'i ngar btags la dug khrag gis sbrus pa'i chos 'byung gru gsum bsnol ba'i steng gi zur rnams thod skam gyis btegs pa'i khar gtor ma zur gsum rtsa ba zlum po gnam lcags kyi thog 'dra ba lto ba dmar po mtha' cung zad nag pa 'khor brgyad/ de'i phyir gtor chung*/ khrag kong lo kong gis bskor ba'i phyi rol du rtsang dmar nyer gcig la rgyu ma'i lda ldi dang bsad shas brgyan pa'i mtshams rnams su mtshe nyungs btsugs/ me ri rgyan spros rngam brjid dang ldan par byas pa'i gtor gdugs kyi 'og tu srung 'khor dang zlog 'khor/ gtor ma'i smad char bsad 'khor bcug /mtha' skor du sman raka gtor gsum/ phyi nang gi nyer spyod/ chos srung dang gzhi bgegs kyi gtor ma/ tshogs 'khor/ skyer mda'/ 'ug sgro ma'i mda' zor/ kong zor/ khrag zor/ rdo zor rnams bzhi re/ ling ga /sgrol gri/ gser skyems/ thun/ zhwa phod/ rol mo sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams bshams/ phrin las kyi gzhung bsrangs te bdag mdun gnyis ka lhan cig tu bsgrub/ thun bzhir byed na thor thun la gtso 'khor rnams kyi bsnyen sngags la srung ba'i sham bu btags pa gtso bor bzlas nas tshogs mchod bsdus pa zhig btang bas/

thun gtor mnan pa'i skabs ltar 'bul/ snga thun la las byang gyer/ bsnyen sngags kyi mjug tu drag sngags la bzlog sham btags te bzla/ tshogs mchod dang thun gtor 'dra/ dgong thun la bsnyen sngags sham du bsad sngags btags nas bzla zhing zor sngags ji ltar rig pas zor yang bsgrub/ tshogs mchod rgyas pa/ bskul/ gdab las/ bzlog gzhung*/ thun gtor 'bul/ srod thun la gtso bo'i rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu shi sa ar gtad sogs kyi sngags tshubs lhong che chung dang bstun te bzla/ tshogs bsdus pa dang thun gtor 'bul/ thun mi byed na gong gi 'dzab rnams rim bzhin bzlas pas nus ldan du byas te tshogs dang po dang bar pa gzhung bzhin btang*/ tshogs tha ma la bskul pa ni/

hūm̐/ dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas// bgegs dpung 'dul mdzad che mchog gro lod rtsal// gtum drag 'bar ba chen po'i skur bzhengs la// lha srin sde brgyad gdugs pa'i 'tshub lhong dang*/ khyad par bod phung mtha' 'dre 'byung po'i tshogs// rgyal bsen dam sri dkor bdag 'gong po yi// lus srog mthu stobs nus pa tshar bcad nas// bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun dgra la sgyur// 'khor lo 'bar ba'i shar gyi rtsibs steng nas// mthu stobs gcig bsdus gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin// gtum drag 'bar ba chen po'i skur bzhengs la// lha srin sde brgyad gdug pa'i 'tshub lhong dang*/ khyad par gza' dang rgyu skar byad stems sogs// steng phyogs gnod byed gdon gyi tshogs rnams kyi// lus srog mthu stobs nus pa tshar bcad nas// bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun dgra la sgyur// 'khor lo 'bar ba lho yi rtsibs steng nas// dus kyi dgra bo 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// gtum drag 'bar ba chen po'i skur bzhengs la// lha srin sde brgyad gdug pa'i 'tshub lhong dang*/ khyad par ban sngags bon dang mu stegs kyis// btang ba'i srung ma lha srin rbad 'dre rnams// lus srog mthu stobs nus pa tshar bcad nas// bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun dgra la sgyur// 'khor lo 'bar ba nub kyi rtsibs steng nas// dbang gi rgyal po rta mchog he ru ka

/gtum drag 'bar ba chen po'i skur bzhengs la// lha srin sde brgyad gdug pa'i 'tshub lhong dang*/ khyad par 'og phyogs klu gnyan sa bdag gi /byad dang sprul pa gdon gyi tshogs bcas kun// lus srog mthu stobs nus pa tshar bcad nas// bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun dgra la sgyur// 'khor lo 'bar ba byang gi rtsibs steng nas// dregs pa tshar gcod yaksha me dbal che// gtum drag 'bar ba chen po'i skur bzhengs la// lha srin sde brgyad gdug pa'i 'tshub lhong dang*/ khyad par rgyal btsan dam sri 'gong po sogs// bar gdon mi bsrun 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyi// lus srog mthu stobs nus pa tshar bcad nas// bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun dgra la sgyur// gzhal yas chen po'i sgo bzhi skyong mdzad pa'i// tshad med bzhi'i gdangs sgo ma bzhir shar ba// gtum drag 'bar ba chen po'i skur bzhengs la// lha srin sde brgyad gdug pa'i 'tshub lhong dang*/ khyad par 'byung po 'gugs bcings bsdams myos nas// btson khang thar med 'brub khung nang bcug ste// lus srog mthu stobs nus pa tshar bcad nas// bar chad mi mthun phyogs kun dgra la sgyur// dbang drag 'bar ba rdo rje gro bo lod// 'khor bcas thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la babs// ma 'ongs lnga brgya mtha' ma shar ba'i tshe// bod kyi sems can las ngan spyod dus 'dir/ khri srong lde'u btsan gdung rgyud mtha' ma la/

khyed kyi thugs rje'i byin gyis brlab tu gsol// deng dus las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te// chos rgyal dmangs su 'bebs pa mi skyob na// dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs dam gang la mdzad// 'gro drug sdug bsngal skyob par mi mdzad na// byang chub sems dpa'i gdul bya gang la dgongs// bod kyi rje 'bangs thugs rjes mi skyob na// padma 'byung gnas mthu rtsal gang la bskyed// dam chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad mi bsrung na// chos skyong bka' srung dam tshig ci la mdzad/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig zhing khams so so'i dbyings nas bzhengs// dgongs shig snyigs ma'i sems can don la dgongs// gshegs shig bod kyi rje 'bangs don la gshegs// dus gsum bde gshegs yi dam lha yi tshogs// padma 'byung gnas rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong srung ma dam can gzhi bdag rnams// mthu rtsal dpung skyed bdag gi bsam pa sgrubs// sangs rgyas bstan pa snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug /bdud kyi sprul pa 'dzam gling khyab par 'dus// bod yul 'di na sdug bsngal khrag mtsho rdol/ khri srong lde'u btsan gdung rgyud dmangs su 'bebs// dben gnas dgon pa rnams su jag chom byed// dmag dpung 'jigs pas sems can gyod la 'bebs// bdud dang 'gong pos sde dpon kha lo sgyur// dam chos tshul bzhin byed du bar chad byas// dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung du ma ster ro// dam can srung ma mchod du ma ster ro// chos rgyal mnga' thang rgyas su 'bangs mgo rgod// bod khams sems can bde ru dmag 'khrugs dar// hūm̐/

bde bar gshegs pa'i dgongs pa sprin ltar gtibs/ khro bo 'jigs pa'i gad mo 'brug ltar sgrog /'gro la brtse ba'i thugs rje glog ltar 'khyug /byin rlabs mthu rtsal drag po thog ltar phob// bdud dang 'gong po dam sri sha za dang*// 'phung byed gdon gyi rigs rnams thal bar rlogs// dug lnga byol nyog rang rgyud 'khrugs pa'i mi// bdud kyi sde dpon rgyal phran cham la phob// las ngan rngams sems me ltar 'bar ba yi// dmag dpon dmag mi rang gshed rang la phob// sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa'i gdon bgegs dang// chos rgyal dmangs su 'bebs pa'i dgra bo dang*// bod khams 'phung bar byed pa'i 'gong po dang*// rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs kun// yid kyis bsam sbyor ngan pa smyo ru chug /ngag gi smra ba lkugs shing brgyal du chug /gdos bcas lus kyi phung po myur du sgrol// bdag cag bar chad 'di las thar bar mdzod// bcol pa'i phrin las ma lus sgrub par mdzod//
ces bskul/ gser skyems/ 'brub khung bskyed chog /dgug gzhug lan gsum mam bdun/ srog yid gzugs gsum 'gugs pa'i sngags ji ltar 'os pa bsgrangs/ mtshe yungs rdo lcags sogs kyi thun brdegs/

hūm̐/ sku stod che mchog padma thod phreng rtsal/ khro gtum rab 'jigs ri rab phur bu 'dril// sku smad gnam lcags phur pa'i dbal ldan pa// tsha sreg rdo rje me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro// btab pas srog rtsa dmar po rbad bcad nas// rnam shes 'og min rgyal ba'i sras su bskrun//
bsnyen sngags dang drag sngags bsad sngags rnams sbrel te phur pa snying gar btab ste tshe khrus kyi dgongs pa bzhin bya/ slar 'khor ba la mi ldog pa'i ched gnas bcur btab/
hūm̐/ mi bzad rno ngar ldan pa'i thog /rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon rnon po// thob cig pho nya las byed tshogs// sha khrag rus pa dum bur gtubs//
zhes gong gi sngags dang bcas rkang pa g.yas nas rim pa bzhin gtubs pa phud bhandhar blugs/ sman raka sbrengs te btegs nas/

sogs brjod/ sgrub pa thon pa'i nub tha mar 'khor ling rnams hom la bsreg cing bzhes sgra drag po lan gsum bya/ bzlog bsgyur ni/

dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la// sde brgyad gdug pa'i gnod pa zlog sgyur mdzod// gsang ba'i bdag po dregs pa kun gyi gshed// g.yas pa rdo rje rwa gdengs mkha' la 'phyar// g.yon pa gnam lcags phur bu bon sngags pa'i rbod gtong zlog sgyur mdzod// rta mchog rol pa dbang drag rol pa'i lha// g.yas pa ma chags thabs kyi padma bsnams// g.yon pa gnam lcags phur bu snying la gzir// sprul pa ging chen pho nya srung ma'i tshogs// sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la// klu gnyan sa bdag gnod pa zlog sgyur mdzod// gtum chen khro bo yaksha me dbal lha// g.yas pa me yi tho bas gdug pa brdungs// g.yon pa gnam lcags phur bu snying la gzir// sprul pa yang sprul pho nya srung ma'i tshogs// sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la// rgyal 'gong 'byung po'i gnod pa zlog sgyur mdzod// phyogs bzhir sgo pa 'di bzhes la// phyogs mtshams gdon gyi dpung tshogs zlog sgyur mdzod// tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs lha yi gdon// brjid pa'i stobs kyis zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// gang ba bzang po la sogs gnod sbyin gdon// 'jigs pa'i stobs kyis zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// za byed rngams pa la sogs srin po'i gdon// rngams pa'i stobs kyis zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// gtso mo kha 'bar la sogs yi dwags gdon// bzhad pa'i stobs kyis zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// byi na ya ga la sogs bgegs kyi gdon// 'gyings pa'i stobs kyis zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// byi tri pa tra la sogs gza' yi gdon// gtum pa'i stobs kyis zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod/

khram thogs gri thogs la sogs bdud kyi gdon// sprul pa'i stobs kyis zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// srog bdag dkar po la sogs ging gi gdon// yang sprul stobs kyis zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// yams shud dmar po la sogs btsan gyi gdon// dregs pa'i stobs kyis zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// tel pa phya sangs la sogs gshin rje'i gdon// sku yi stobs kyis zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// ral gcig nag po la sogs ma mo'i gdon// gsung gi stobs kyis zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// rol pa rkya bdun la sogs dmu yi gdon// mgo brnyan stobs kyis zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// ma hā de wa la sogs mu stegs gdon// bden pa'i stobs kyis zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// dga' bo 'jog po la sogs klu yi gdon// gdug pa'i stobs kyis zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// pe har rgyal po la sogs rgyal po'i gdon/ khro gtum stobs kyis zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// nag mo re ti la sogs bdud mo'i gdon// nga rgyal stobs kyis zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// lha srin sde brgyad la sogs 'byung po'i gdon// gdug pa 'dul mdzad khro bos zlog tu gsol// bhyoḥ mon nag 'jigs pa'i cha byad can// mdze pho'i 'khor gyis bskor ba ni// las kyi gshin rje'i cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis// de yang steng 'phrad steng du zlog

/de yang 'og 'phrad 'og tu zlog /de yang phyogs 'phrad phyogs su zlog /de yang mtshams 'phrad mtshams su zlog /dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du zlog /nag mo drel zhon khro baṃ can// bud med nag mo'i 'khor gyis bskor// nad gtong ma mo'i cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis// de yang steng 'phrad steng du zlog /de yang 'og 'phrad 'og tu zlog /de yang phyogs 'phrad phyogs su zlog /de yang mtshams 'phrad mtshams su zlog /dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du zlog /mi nag rta nag dar nag can// bya nag khyi nag 'phur zhing nyer// nag po bdud kyi cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis// de yang steng 'phrad steng du zlog /de yang 'og 'phrad 'og tu= de yang phyogs 'phrad phyogs su= de yang mtshams 'phrad mtshams su= dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du= mi dkar spyang dang seng ge zhon// bya dkar khyi dkar skya shar 'gyed// srog bdag ging gi cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis// de yang steng 'phrad= de yang 'og 'phrad= de yang phyogs 'phrad= de yang mtshams 'phrad= dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du= bud med nag mo mdzo zhon dang*// bya nag sbra gur nag po ni// ma bdud rgyal mo'i cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis// de yang steng= de yang 'og= de yang phyogs= de yang mtshams= dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du=

mi dkar dar mdung dkar po can// mi rta dkar pos bskor ba ni// snang srid lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis/ de yang steng= de yang 'og= de yang phyogs= de yang mtshams= dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du= bshan pa gri thog dred kyi gzugs// gcan gzan mang pos bskor ba ni// sha za srin po'i cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis// de yang steng= de yang 'og= de yang phyogs= de yang mtshams= dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du= bud med mi sdug gcan gzan zhon// nag mo khros mas bskor ba ni// nag mo srin mo'i cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis// de yang steng= de yang 'og= de yang phyogs= de yang mtshams= dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du= mi dmar rta dmar zhon nas ni// skyes phran btsan 'dras bskor ba ni// dmar po btsan gyi cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis// de yang steng= de yang 'og= de yang phyogs= de yang mtshams= dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du= btsun pa btsad po 'bag seng dang*// rol mo lha khang sku gzugs ni// rgyal po chen po'i cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis// de yang steng= de yang 'og= de yang phyogs= de yang mtshams= dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du= 'dab chags phug ron 'phur zhing lding*// mun pa nag po 'thibs pa ni// nag po dmu yi cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis/

de yang steng= de yang 'og= de yang phyogs= de yang mtshams= dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du= spyang ki sngon mo nyer zhing rgyug /bandhe nag po smyug zhu can// rdo rje legs pa'i cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis// de yang steng= de yang 'og= de yang phyogs= de yang mtshams= dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du= mi lus gcan gzan pags pa gyon// lus las me stag 'phro ba ni// gnod sbyin pho mo'i cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis// de yang steng= de yang 'og= de yang phyogs= de yang mtshams= dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du= ban nag bon nag ber nag can// nag po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni// chos skyong mgon po'i cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis// de yang steng= de yang 'og= de yang phyogs= de yang mtshams= dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du= sprang po hrul po glang mkhar can// spra sprel byi las bskor ba ni// the'u rang 'gong po'i cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis// de yang steng= de yang 'og= de yang phyogs= de yang mtshams= dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du= sprang po khyi spyang rgol ba dang*// btsun pa dam nyams la sogs pa// dam sri pho mo'i cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis// de yang steng= de yang 'og= de yang phyogs= de yang mtshams= dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du= ba glang sbal sbrul sdom sdig dang*// mtsho nag ne 'u chu mig ni// sa bdag klu gnyan cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis// de yang steng=

de yang 'og= de yang phyogs= de yang mtshams= dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du= thog babs sgyogs dang mda' rdo 'phen// ser ba 'bab cing rlung nag 'tshubs// rbod gtong spyi yi cho 'phrul yin// dmar chen sha khrag gtor ma yis// de yang steng= de yang 'og= de yang phyogs= de yang mtshams 'phrad mtshams su zlog /dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du zlog /hūm̐/ che mchog padma gro bo lod// zlog bsgyur byed pa'i stobs po che/ khrom kha sgyur ba'i mthu bo che// zor kha sgyur ba'i drag rtsal can// bdud kha sgyur ba'i nga ro can// do nub srid pa'i khram kha sgyur// do nub lha 'di'i dmag sna sgyur// phas kyis rbod gtong byed pa zlog /yungs zor mtshe zor 'phen pa zlog /'byung po'i thod zor 'phen pa= gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba= phur pa'i dbal zor 'phen pa= ma mo'i khrag zor 'phen pa zlog /bdud kyis khram la 'debs pa zlog /rgyal pos thog rgyug byed pa= btsan gyis shwa rdel 'phen pa= gza' yis king kang 'phen pa= srin pos za res byed pa= gnod sbyin pho mo'i gdug rtsub= klu yis byad du bcug pa= lha chad gnam las 'beb pa= mu stegs bar chad byed pa= ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig= ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu= bram zes tshe la rku ba= dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad= bandhes sngags zor 'phen pa= bon pos btso dmar 'phen pa= sum pas glang zor 'phen pa=

skyes pa'i mda' zor 'phen pa= bud med nag mo'i dmod mo= ban bon smreng zor 'phen pa= dgra bcom rnams kyi dmod mo= 'char ka'i pa bu'i bskor ba= srid pa'i dal kha g.yos pa= mo ngan chad kha che ba= rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa= lo skag zla skag thams cad= zhag dus za skag thams cad= rgya 'dre stong 'dre byed pa= pho nyas rbod gtong byed pa= yas kyi bdud du babs pa= mas kyi sri ru langs pa= ltag pa'i bdud du babs pa= dpral ba'i gshed du 'khor ba= dur mig dur sri langs pa= g.yas na pho brgyas mda' brdar= g.yon na mo brgyas dug sbyor= mdun na rtsang bzhin 'dzugs pa= rgyab nas khyi bzhin 'brang ba= ngos nas gdong thug byed pa= lkog nas 'bu bzhin g.yeng ba= mi la nad du gtong ba= tshe la bar du gcod pa= phyugs la god kha byed pa= gnam gyi dal kha 'bab pa= sa yi nad dal byung ba bzlog /mi mthun gnod pa ma lus pa// thams cad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod//
sgo dbye'i thun gtor 'bul/ gser skyems btang*/ sgo dbye tshe bdag bzhin byas te gtor ma dpag /tshogs lhag dang chad tho dmag lto'i tshul du gtong*/ gtor ma 'phen pa gser skyems kyi rjes su/

zhes pas 'phen/ bshal chus brtan ma skyong*/ me chu'i rgyas 'debs/ nang du log nas tshe 'gugs gtang raka bzod gsol rten la brtan bzhugs bya/ mgron gshegs pa smon lam/ shis brjod rnams dkyus ltar byed do// mthu stobs rnon po'i sbar mo gdengs tsam gyis// bgegs dpung glang po'i spyi bo nyer phug nas// klad khrag 'dres dang lhan cig don snying kyang*// lkog mar bros nas da dung 'dar snyam byed// de 'dra padma thod phreng thugs kyi bcud// mngon sum longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang 'di// gter chen chos kyi rgyal po legs ldan rje'i// gzhal dka'i bka' drin pha mtha' gang gis tshol// blos byas 'og 'gyu'i bslad pa ma zhugs par// tshul bzhin lag tu longs dang yid srubs sde// thal bar brlags pa'i rjes shul da gdod nas// yang rnyed brod dga'i nyams kyis myur du myong*// 'khrul med rtsa tho'i dgongs pa ma 'phyugs shing*/ kha skong tshad ma'i gter byon dpang bzhag las// rang bzos ma gos 'on kyang dman pa'i blos// nongs na rtsa gsum lha tshogs spyan sngar bshags// dge ba'i rlung gis rtsa gsum thugs rje'i zhugs// 'bar bas gdon bgegs nags tshal cher bsregs pa'i// tsha drod rtsub mo'i reg bya'i dbal gyi rtses// dga' rab dbang phyug sder bcas phyer 'thag shog /ces che mchog padma rdo rje gro lod rtsal gyi phrin las dbang chog mnan bsreg 'phang gsum dang bcas pa phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa gnam lcags 'bar ba zhes bya ba 'di bka' bab lung zin gyi gtso bo byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i mchog sprul dang*/
